patch.value: Node 22 exact branch coverage is nondeterministic across identical CI reruns

On pm-changelog PR 128 exact head a152fe7, Node 22.23.1 attempt one ran all 406 tests successfully but reported cli.ts at 99.52 branch and aggregate 99.93; the unchanged failed-job rerun reported exact 100/100/100 and passed. Node 26 and local Node 22.19.0 were exact. A gate that alternates without code changes is not trustworthy even when the rerun is green.

value.text: Root cause evidence: Node 22.23.1 local run 3 before the fix lost cli.ts lines 262-263 despite 406 passing tests. After directly covering that file-output explain path, a second repeated run exposed five nondeterministic zero-hit branch records at cli.ts lines 215, 237, 295, 296, and 303. These were modes exercised only through child-process CLI tests, whose V8 branch aggregation varied between identical runs. The final test change exercises explained Markdown summary, explained semver, and stdout JSON/Markdown workflow-output behavior in-process; it does not lower thresholds, ignore code, or add artificial branches. Verification: 10 consecutive Node 22.23.1 gates and 3 consecutive Node 26.7.0 gates passed, 406 tests per run, every one of nine sources exact 100 lines/branches/functions, and each retained cli.ts LCOV record had zero missing branch arms. A full Node 26.7.0 release:check also passed typecheck, 100 percent docstrings, exact coverage, zero production vulnerabilities, package dry-run, and changelog check.
